guideImpact.affectedSection: Automobile HTTP Browsing, Ping and Video Streaming results
guideImpact.reason: The reviewed behaviour adds selectable Automobile map results for HTTP Browsing, Ping and Video Streaming, with new point-detail dialogs and test-specific KPIs, plus distinct error styling for failed HTTP results. The current guide index documents Automobile Service results only, leaving these user instructions and visible details undocumented.
